verdict.rationale: First-party docs say cloud backups and cross-device sync are end-to-end encrypted, and that data is encrypted with a key derived from the user's password. Local backups are password-encrypted with a password Ente cannot recover, which supports the claim that the vendor never holds the key. The apps and server are described as open source. Missing for 10: a published cryptographic design or whitepaper (algorithms, key hierarchy, key-derivation parameters) beyond a one-line mention of password-derived keys, and independent audit or hands-on corroboration of the zero-knowledge claim.
